sentences: This describes a Address entity in the domain.
The Address record participates in downstream tool operations.
Address.street: Street address including house/apartment number
Address.city: City name
Address.state: State or province code (e.g., CA, NY)
Address.zip_code: Postal/ZIP code
This describes a Plan entity in the domain.
The Plan record participates in downstream tool operations.
Plan.plan_id: Unique identifier for the plan
Plan.name: Display name of the plan
Plan.data_limit_gb: Monthly data allowance in gigabytes (GB)
Plan.price_per_month: Monthly price of the plan in USD
This describes a DeviceType entity in the domain.
The DeviceType record participates in downstream tool operations.
This describes a Device entity in the domain.
The Device record participates in downstream tool operations.
Device.device_id: Unique identifier for the device
Device.device_type: Type/category of the device
Device.model: Model name/number of the device
Device.imei: International Mobile Equipment Identity number
This describes a LineStatus entity in the domain.
The LineStatus record participates in downstream tool operations.
This describes a Line entity in the domain.
The Line record participates in downstream tool operations.
Line.line_id: Unique identifier for the line
Line.phone_number: Phone number associated with the line
Line.status: Current status of the line
Line.plan_id: Plan associated with this line
This describes a LineItem entity in the domain.
The LineItem record participates in downstream tool operations.
LineItem.description: Descriptive text for the line item
LineItem.amount: Monetary amount in USD (positive for charges, negative for credits)
LineItem.date: Date the line item was applied (format: YYYY-MM-DD, timezone: EST)
LineItem.item_type: Category of the line item (e.g., Plan Charge, Overage, Fee, Credit, Payment)
This describes a BillStatus entity in the domain.
The BillStatus record participates in downstream tool operations.
This describes a Bill entity in the domain.
The Bill record participates in downstream tool operations.
Bill.bill_id: Unique identifier for the bill
Bill.customer_id: ID of the customer this bill belongs to
Bill.period_start: Start date of the billing period (format: YYYY-MM-DD, timezone: EST)
Bill.period_end: End date of the billing period (format: YYYY-MM-DD, timezone: EST)
This describes a AccountStatus entity in the domain.
The AccountStatus record participates in downstream tool operations.
This describes a PaymentMethodType entity in the domain.
The PaymentMethodType record participates in downstream tool operations.
This describes a PaymentMethod entity in the domain.
The PaymentMethod record participates in downstream tool operations.
PaymentMethod.method_type: Type of payment method
PaymentMethod.account_number_last_4: Last 4 digits of the account number
PaymentMethod.expiration_date: The expiration date of the payment method in the format MM/YYYY
This describes a Customer entity in the domain.
The Customer record participates in downstream tool operations.
Customer.customer_id: Unique identifier for the customer
Customer.full_name: Customer's full name
Customer.date_of_birth: Customer's date of birth for identity verification (format: YYYY-MM-DD)
Customer.email: Customer's email address
This describes a TelecomDB entity in the domain.
The TelecomDB record participates in downstream tool operations.
TelecomDB.plans: Available service plans
TelecomDB.customers: All customers in the system
TelecomDB.lines: All lines in the system
TelecomDB.bills: All bills in the system
This tool gets a request to produce a Customer.
Invoke get_customer_by_phone when the user needs to get a Customer.
Finds a customer by their primary contact or line phone number.
This tool gets Customer to produce a Customer.
Invoke get_customer_by_id when the user needs to get a Customer.
Retrieves a customer directly by their unique ID.
This tool gets a request to produce a Customer.
Invoke get_customer_by_name when the user needs to get a Customer.
Searches for customers by name and DOB. May return multiple matches if names are similar,
This tool gets a request to produce a Dict[str, Any].
Invoke get_details_by_id when the user needs to get a Dict[str, Any].
Retrieves the details for a given ID.
This tool suspends Customer and Line to produce a Dict[str, Any].
Invoke suspend_line when the user needs to suspend a Dict[str, Any].
Suspends a specific line (max 6 months).
This tool resumes Customer and Line to produce a Dict[str, Any].
Invoke resume_line when the user needs to resume a Dict[str, Any].
Resumes a suspended line.
This tool gets Customer to produce a Bill.
Invoke get_bills_for_customer when the user needs to get a Bill.
Retrieves a list of the customer's bills, most recent first.
This tool sends Bill and Customer to produce a str.
Invoke send_payment_request when the user needs to send a str.
Sends a payment request to the customer for a specific bill.
This tool gets Customer and Line to produce a Dict[str, Any].
Invoke get_data_usage when the user needs to get a Dict[str, Any].
Retrieves current billing cycle data usage for a line, including data
This tool enables Customer and Line to produce a Dict[str, Any].
Invoke enable_roaming when the user needs to enable a Dict[str, Any].
Enables international roaming on a line.
This tool disables Customer and Line to produce a str.
Invoke disable_roaming when the user needs to disable a str.
Disables international roaming on a line.
This tool transfers a request to produce a str.
Invoke transfer_to_human_agents when the user needs to transfer a str.
Transfer the user to a human agent, with a summary of the user's issue.
This tool refuels Customer and Line to produce a Dict[str, Any].
Invoke refuel_data when the user needs to refuel a Dict[str, Any].
Refuels data for a specific line, adding to the customer's bill.

The DeviceType is a component of the Device record.
Operations on Device may read or modify its DeviceType via device_type.

Operations on Customer may read or modify its PaymentMethod via payment_methods.

Operations on Customer may read or modify its Line via line_ids.
A Customer contains a Bill accessed via its bill_ids attribute.
The Bill is a component of the Customer record.
Operations on Customer may read or modify its Bill via bill_ids.
A TelecomDB contains a Plan accessed via its plans attribute.
The Plan is a component of the TelecomDB record.
Operations on TelecomDB may read or modify its Plan via plans.
A TelecomDB contains a Customer accessed via its customers attribute.
The Customer is a component of the TelecomDB record.
Operations on TelecomDB may read or modify its Customer via customers.
A TelecomDB contains a Line accessed via its lines attribute.
The Line is a component of the TelecomDB record.
Operations on TelecomDB may read or modify its Line via lines.

The Bill is a component of the TelecomDB record.
Operations on TelecomDB may read or modify its Bill via bills.
